definitions: The unstated or inherent boundaries and extent of a project, agreement, or task, understood through context rather than explicit declaration.
The range of activities, responsibilities, or deliverables that are implicitly included in a plan or contract, even if not formally documented.
examples: The team quickly realized the implied scope of the project was much larger than initially discussed.
Understanding the implied scope is crucial for avoiding misunderstandings later on.
Her role had an implied scope that extended beyond her job description.
